meta.source: Eskom Weekly System Status Report, 2026 Week 36, "Estimated Rooftop PV" provincial table, Jul-26 row. Verbatim except Northern Cape 758.4, split to Hydra Central on the 82/18 ratio used for the Jun-26 figure. REPLACED the Jun-26 row on 8 Sep 2026 - rule 5, replace the whole block rather than adding the delta.
meta.caveat: Eskom footnotes this series: "Rooftop PV includes ground-mounted as well as all other PV installations that do not have contracts with NTCSA." The bucket is contractual, not physical, so an unknown slice is ground-mounted grid-connected plant being modelled as demand suppression. The provincial split shows it: the Northern Cape carries 583 W per person against Gauteng 190, in a province with few roofs and every large solar farm.
